conceptual assets.concept: Data memory contents (bytes stored in DMEM arrays)
conceptual assets.reasoning: The clocked mem_access process updates the memory arrays under bus writes and per-byte enables: e.g. `if (bus_req_i.stb = '1') and (bus_req_i.rw = '1') then if (bus_req_i.ben(0) = '1') mem_ram_b0(to_integer(addr)) <= bus_req_i.data(7 downto 0); end if;` and similarly for mem_ram_b1..b3. Reads source the same arrays into rdata: e.g. `rdata(7 downto 0) <= mem_ram_b0(to_integer(addr));`. The correctness of reads and stored state depends on these arrays' contents, establishing an Integrity objective for the stored DMEM bytes.

conceptual assets.concept: Read-data value produced for bus responses
conceptual assets.reasoning: The signal `rdata` is assigned from the memory arrays (e.g. `rdata(31 downto 24) <= mem_ram_b3(to_integer(addr));`) and is the value offered on the response interface via `bus_rsp_o.data <= rdata when (rden = '1') else (others => '0');`. The value delivered to the requester depends on `rdata`; its integrity must hold so responses reflect the stored memory contents.

conceptual assets.concept: Selected memory address index used for reads and writes
conceptual assets.reasoning: The concurrent assignment `addr <= unsigned(bus_req_i.addr(addr_hi_c downto 2));` computes the word index that the mem_access process uses as `to_integer(addr)` when writing (`mem_ram_b0(to_integer(addr)) <= ...`) and when reading (`rdata(...) <= mem_ram_b0(to_integer(addr));`). If this computed index is incorrect, the module will access wrong memory locations, establishing Integrity for the address index.

conceptual assets.concept: Read-enable decision that gates whether read data is presented
conceptual assets.reasoning: The bus_feedback process stores the read-enable decision: `rden <= bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw);` (on rising_edge(clk_i)). That stored `rden` value is used to select response data (`bus_rsp_o.data <= rdata when (rden = '1') else (others => '0');`). The correctness of this decision controls whether read data is exposed, establishing Integrity for rden.
